holder-quote: He screamed as the bolts flew and the [Assassins] rode through their own fire to strike at him. Left—right—ahead—the Rabbit [Courier] shouted as he ran at the wagons.
effect-quote: The [Assassins] saw him blur. The ones braced blinked. He was coming even faster. Twice as fast—

holder-quote: The five were talking as the sun rose. Snapjaw revealed one of her Skills—[Body: Restore Stamina], as well as a Skill close to Hawk’s [Physical Overdrive]. However, both relied on her stores of energy from food.
Hawk stormed over, and Sasquatch jumped.
effect-quote: He accelerated, and now he was using his Skill.
